card.name: Inside split or run-together drug names
card.fires_on: Short word pieces in the middle of a drug name or technical term that is broken up or run together without spaces, such as 'ETH' before 'AMOL' or 'ibandronate'. Also fires on odd joins in command names and web addresses.

modes.label: Broken drug names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug or chemical name that is split by odd spacing or merged text, often right after a heading.

modes.label: Run-together text
